text: Only that the Director's had the interrogation suite cleared. Nobody's said for who. Nobody needs to.
style: An off-duty SAFETYNET agent in his forties pretending to read while eavesdropping on everyone. Consistent Geordie (Newcastle) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, conspiratorial pitch; unhurried pace. Gossipy and paranoid, enjoying the drama a little too much.
